blocks.text: CAMP GEN. MARIANO N. LLANERA, Nueva Ecija — At least 400 police officers from the Nueva Ecija Police Provincial Office (NEPPO) have been deployed to the National Capital Region (NCR) to augment security forces for the 2026 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, police said Saturday, Nov. 14.
